title: Polish Cheese Casserole
description: A hearty, cheesy casserole with a warm and wholesome taste, inspired by Polish cuisine.

ingredients.name: Polish cheese
ingredients.notes: Look for a mix of cheddar and mozzarella for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Mashed potatoes
ingredients.notes: Use leftover mashed potatoes for a convenient shortcut

ingredients.name: Caramelized onions
ingredients.notes: Slow-cook sliced onions in butter until they're dark and sweet

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Add a pop of color and freshness with chopped parsley

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper
ingredients.notes: Season to taste with salt and pepper

ingredients.name: Unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: Use unsalted butter for a more delicate flavor

instructions: In a large skillet, cook the caramelized onions and butter over medium heat until heated through.
In a separate bowl, mix together the mashed potatoes, Polish cheese, and chopped parsley.
Transfer the potato mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top the potato mixture with the caramelized onion mixture.
Dot the top with unsalted butter.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
